description: KASPI Global Resource Fabric — Terms of Service, Commercial Rights & Regulatory Compliance

complianceFrameworks.name: Loi N° 09-08 relative à la protection des personnes physiques à l'égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel (CNDP Maroc)
complianceFrameworks.impact: Mandates customer personal data (phone numbers, debt balances, full names) cannot be transferred outside approved jurisdictions without CNDP authorization or strong encryption at rest.
complianceFrameworks.implementation: Customer PII is stored encrypted in database, and zero raw customer personal data is ever dispatched to community compute nodes or third-party workers.

complianceFrameworks.name: Article 145 du Code Général des Impôts (DGI Maroc)
complianceFrameworks.impact: Mandates all POS and invoicing software preserve sequential, gapless numbering with zero alteration or retroactive suppression.
complianceFrameworks.implementation: Protected by PostgreSQL transactional row locks (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) and append-only immutable audit logs.

complianceFrameworks.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR)
complianceFrameworks.impact: Right to erasure, data portability, and processor contractual obligations for European users and tenants.
complianceFrameworks.implementation: Tenant-level isolation, cryptographically shreddable tenant keys, and deterministic data export via /api/v1/reports.
